H01.description: When set-cookie is first set with an array, head stores the caller's array by reference, so later set-cookie calls push into (mutate) the caller's array, making a shared/module-level array grow and leak cookies across requests.

H03.description: Adds a regression test that a caller's set-cookie array is not mutated.

I01.description: Stream trailer timing fix in sendStream is unrelated to the set-cookie header behaviour of this change; nothing shown ties it to the head code under review.
